progress.scanning: Searching your network for iCON controllers. This takes a few seconds.

select.title: Choose a controller
select.description: Several iCON controllers were found on your network. Each shows its address, the end of its system ID and its firmware version; "SYSID ?" means the firmware is too old to reveal the system ID, which you will be asked for.

data_description.host: The address and the end of the system ID help you tell them apart.

data_description.sysid: The controller's firmware is too old to reveal it. It is the number on the iCON PASS card or on the controller's label.

manual.title: Enter the controller
manual.description: No controller was found automatically. Its address is shown in the thermostat service menu (INTERNET STATUS) and on your router.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the iCON master controller.
data_description.sysid: Only needed for firmware older than 1079: the number on the iCON PASS card or on the controller's label.

data_description.host: New IP address or host name of the same controller.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter the system ID
reauth_confirm.description: The controller at {host} did not accept the stored system ID.

data_description.sysid: The number on the iCON PASS card or on the controller's label.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller on TCP port 7992. Check that it is powered and on the same network as Home Assistant, and that no firewall blocks the port.
error.invalid_sysid: The controller does not accept this system ID.
error.sysid_required: This controller runs firmware older than 1079 and does not reveal its system ID. Enter it as well.
error.not_icon: The device answered, but it is not an NGBS iCON controller.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This iCON system is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This iCON system is already being set up.
abort.not_icon: The device is not an NGBS iCON controller.
abort.wrong_system: This address belongs to a different iCON system. Add it as a new integration instead.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the controller is read, in seconds. Changes made in Home Assistant appear at once regardless.

auth_failed.message: The controller rejected the system ID.

sysid_missing.message: The system ID of the controller is not known yet.

value_rejected.message: The thermostat did not accept {value}; it is outside the range allowed for it.

hc_switch_not_allowed.message: Heating and cooling can only be switched on the H/C master thermostat ({master}).

hc_switch_external.message: Heating and cooling are switched by an input or centrally in this system, not by a thermostat, so Home Assistant cannot change the mode. See the repair issue for details.

write_rejected.message: The controller did not apply the change ({field}: {value}). If heating/cooling is switched by an external input, use that switch.

old_firmware.title: {title}: controller firmware is out of date
old_firmware.description: The controller runs firmware {firmware}. From version {required} it reveals its system ID on the network, so Home Assistant can find it automatically and follow it when its address changes. Update it in the thermostat's service menu: UPGRADE FROM THE NET.

thermostat_offline.title: {name} does not communicate
thermostat_offline.description: Thermostat {name} ({id}) of {title} has not communicated with the controller for over an hour, so its values and settings are unavailable. Check its power supply and the bus cable. If it was removed for good, uninstall it in the controller configuration; Home Assistant then removes it as well.

hc_switch_external.title: {title}: heating/cooling is switched outside Home Assistant
hc_switch_external.description: Heating and cooling are switched by {source} (an input of the controller or a central switch), not by a thermostat. The controller ignores mode changes sent over the network, so Home Assistant only shows the mode. Switch it with the external switch, or ask the installer to make a thermostat the H/C master.

duplicate_system.title: NGBS iCON system set up twice
duplicate_system.description: The entry "{title}", taken over from the earlier NGBS iCON integration, controls the same system as "{other}". Both read and control the controller. Delete one of them under Settings → Devices & services.

set_setpoints.name: Set setpoints
set_setpoints.description: Changes several setpoints of the thermostats in one step, including the ones that are not in effect now (for example the cooling setpoint in winter).

heating.name: Heating
heating.description: Leave empty to keep the current value.

cooling.name: Cooling
cooling.description: Leave empty to keep the current value.

eco_heating.name: Eco heating
eco_heating.description: Leave empty to keep the current value.

eco_cooling.name: Eco cooling
eco_cooling.description: Leave empty to keep the current value.

set_system_mode.name: Set system mode
set_system_mode.description: Switches the whole system between heating and cooling. The controller switches its changeover relays several minutes later.

config_entry_id.name: System
config_entry_id.description: The NGBS iCON system; can be left empty when only one is set up.

restart_controller.name: Restart controller
restart_controller.description: Restarts the controller software. Regulation pauses for a moment; the settings are kept.

config_entry_id.name: System
config_entry_id.description: The NGBS iCON system; can be left empty when only one is set up.
